title: AI Workflow Output Envelope
description: Shared response envelope for every AI workflow. Workflow-specific output schemas extend this and narrow the 'results' property to their own results schema. Defined once here rather than repeated per workflow.

status.description: PARTIAL is first-class: some fields extracted, others failed. Never collapse PARTIAL into SUCCESS or FAILED - that is how silent data loss happens.

prompt_version.description: Required for audit under BR-05. Must match the deployed prompt version (VR-06).

model_id.description: Exact model identifier including snapshot date. Required for audit under BR-05.

confidence_aggregate.description: PROVISIONAL. Currently model-self-reported and uncalibrated. Thresholds in Validation.md section 6 are unvalidated until Phase 4.3 calibration against the golden set. Do not treat 0.85 as meaningful yet.

error_code.description: Set when status is FAILED. See Error_Handling.md.

results.description: Narrowed by each workflow's output schema. Never leave this as a bare object - that was the defect this schema set exists to fix.

json_pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into the results object, e.g. /profile/experience/0/company. Used so the review console can locate any field generically instead of hardcoding field names.

evidence_ref.description: A verbatim source snippet supporting a conclusion. VR-03 requires match_score >= 0.8 when fuzzy-matched back against the source document; below that, raise POTENTIAL_HALLUCINATION. This is the primary defense against fabricated extractions.

field.description: Human-readable field name, or a JSON Pointer into results.

snippet.description: Verbatim from source. Max 25 words per the system prompt.

char_start.description: Offset into extracted text. Required for click-to-highlight in the review console.

match_score.description: Fuzzy-match score of snippet against source text, computed by the validator - not by the model.
